titleEn: Number of Students Unable to Eat Lunch
title: 无法吃午餐的学生数量
summary: 学生按队列等待，三明治按栈顶顺序；喜欢顶层的学生拿走，否则移到队尾，求最终无法进餐人数。
insight: 学生轮转顺序无需真实模拟，只要还有喜欢当前三明治类型的学生，就总能轮到他。统计两种偏好，遇到某类库存为零时剩余三明治数就是答案。
pitfalls: 一旦当前三明治无人喜欢，之后全部停止

solutions.title: 偏好计数
solutions.idea: 用两类学生数量替代循环队列。
steps: 若 count[type]==0 返回剩余数量，否则 count[type]--；全部取完返回零

code.java: class Solution { public int countStudents(int[] students,int[] sandwiches){int[] count=new int[2];for(int student:students)count[student]++;for(int i=0;i<sandwiches.length;i++){int type=sandwiches[i];if(count[type]==0)return sandwiches.length-i;count[type]--;}return 0;} }
code.kotlin: class Solution { fun countStudents(students:IntArray,sandwiches:IntArray):Int{val count=IntArray(2);for(student in students)count[student]++;for(i in sandwiches.indices){val type=sandwiches[i];if(count[type]==0)return sandwiches.size-i;count[type]--};return 0} }
code.cpp: class Solution { public: int countStudents(vector<int>& students,vector<int>& sandwiches){int count[2]={};for(int student:students)++count[student];for(int i=0;i<(int)sandwiches.size();++i){int type=sandwiches[i];if(!count[type])return sandwiches.size()-i;--count[type];}return 0;} };
